# Paris

Paris is the capital and largest city of France. With an official estimated population
of 2,102,650 as of January 2023, it is the fifth-most populated city in the European Union.

## Geography

Paris is located in northern France, in a north-bending arc of the river Seine.
The city covers an area of 105.4 square kilometres (40.7 sq mi).

## History

The history of Paris dates back to approximately 259 BC, with the Parisii,
a sub-tribe of the Celtic Senones, inhabiting the area.

## Landmarks

### Eiffel Tower

The Eiffel Tower is a wrought-iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars in Paris.
It is named after the engineer Gustave Eiffel, whose company designed and built the tower
from 1887 to 1889 as the centerpiece of the 1889 World's Fair.

### Louvre Museum

The Louvre is the world's most-visited museum and a historic landmark in Paris.
It is home to approximately 380,000 objects and displays 35,000 works of art.

## Demographics

The population of Paris proper is about 2.1 million. The Paris metropolitan area
has a population of about 13 million, making it the largest in the European Union.
